source_reviews.locator: Product title, CAS and purity fields; size selector; embedded application/json product variants and formatted lead_time; JSON-LD offers
source_reviews.observations: Five pack sizes have Ships Today labels and positive variant availability. The 205L variant has a later shipping date and is not counted as same-day stock. Generic Unavailable fallback text coexists with the populated variant data.
The web index labels the primary page as crawled six days ago. Its US/Japan stock table is retained with that age; retrieval time is not relabeled as the stock observation time.
An alternative Fisher supplier page was saved and identifies the exact material; its retrieved HTML does not establish current item-level stock.

The indexed Sigma page instructs checking the cart for availability. Fisher provides an exact product listing without an explicit current stock response in the saved HTML; Wako returned 404. No cart was changed.

Exact identity is supported by the retrieved PubChem response and Thermo specification. TargetMol direct access returned 412; its search result has inquiry-only item rows. INDOFINE retrieval failed TLS verification, which was not disabled.

The displayed CAS, formula, InChIKey and SMILES identify the configured stearolic-acid terminal. The PDF displays print date 2026-09-14 although retrieved on 2026-09-13 UTC; this is preserved and is not used to date a stock observation.

locators: New article transcription, printed page 4769, general Parikh-Doering procedure
Original ACS SI page 5, compound 8d, with neighboring pages 4 and 6 visually inspected
source_reviews.observations: The original SI visibly reports compound 8d, 17-octadecynal, its 52 percent isolated yield and product-specific characterization. The new transcription supplies the general-procedure text, but contains no usable scheme images. The university record identifies the published article and labels its main file Login required; no restricted file was downloaded. Product characterization alone does not complete the new route qualification.
